context_requirements: Cardiomyogenesis inducers act on developmental or cardiac-lineage contexts; the nine lines are cancer lines without cardiomyogenic potential.
No annotated targets are listed for this class, so no direct transcriptional signature can be predicted.
A response would require cardiac mesoderm competence or relevant cardiac transcription factor networks, which are absent in these lines.
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of cardiac lineage markers (e.g., TNNT2, MYH7, NPPA) in any of the nine lines at 6 or 24 h.
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is not explained by generic stress, proliferation, or cytotoxicity.
Dose-dependent changes in landmark genes consistent with activation of a known cardiomyogenesis pathway.
